newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-FAI clarifies St Moritz option deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-FAI clarifies St Moritz option deal.

text.p: FAI Insurances Ltd said on Tuesday a possible joint venture to develop its St Moritz hotel in New York with the Trump Organisation would only be profitable for Trump after FAI had received US$180 million from the sale of the property.

FAI said on Monday it had entered into a consultancy agreement with Trump to examine development opportunities for its St Moritz hotel in New York and the company expected this to lead to a joint venture with Trump.

"It is proposed the Trump Organisation will only participate in the profitability of the project after FAI has received US$180 million from the sale of the property, details of which will depend on the ultimate development option pursued," the company said in a statement.
FAI acquired the 688-room St Moritz Hotel for US$175 million from Bond Corp Holdings Ltd in 1990 as a debt repayment.
At 12.00 p.m. (0100 GMT), FAI shares were two cents weaker at 74 cents.
The stock climbed six cents or 8.57 percent to 76 cents on Monday as speculation about the deal, which was announced late in the afternoon, filtered through the market.
